title: flow-condition-option-label now reads filters and edge conditions: the automation skill's trap sentence and the os explain text still describe the start condition only
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2uhJ1AYNPw5TUSVS

Filing gate: ① owed follow-up of PR #37491 (#36964): shipped text that the PR makes false, fenced off that card. Source: fleet (os-dev report 7187822605 on #36964, open questions 1 and 2; zone o5-P chose a follow-up for both).
Blocked-by: #37491

Once #37491 merges, `flow-condition-option-label` (error) also reads get_record / update_record / delete_record filter operands, a time-relative filter, edge conditions and decision `conditions[].expression`. Two texts still say otherwise:

- [ ] `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` §4: "A label in a filter or an edge condition is never checked: it silently matches nothing". After #37491 it is refused by `os validate` and the publish gate; the escape hatch for a deliberate label filter is a CEL value envelope. ⚠ `skills/**` is governed: its own PR, governed handoff.
- [ ] `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` `FLOW_CONDITION_OPTION_LABEL_EXPLANATION` ("why a start condition compares option values") describes the start condition only. Held by open PR #37422 today: edit after it lands, or let its holder fold it in.

## Business reason
An author or AI reading the skill is told a label filter silently matches nothing, while `os validate` now refuses it; `os explain` describes a narrower rule than the one that fired.

Suggested-grade: p2 · area:build · Bug · docs/skill text wrong after a lint change.
Dedupe: `automation skill option label filter`, `flow-condition-option-label explanation` → no open card.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#36964.
